title: macadress.com Enrichment
description: Internal enrichment connector for Mac-Addr observables. Resolves the IEEE-registered vendor, an inferred device category, virtualization and special-use classification, and MAC-randomization confidence from the macadress.com API, then updates the observable and links it to a vendor Organization identity.
short_description: Enriches Mac-Addr observables with vendor, device and MAC-randomization intelligence.
